summary: Frontend ERP testing — comprehensive coverage of all roles (super_admin / center_manager / counsellor), all 8 nav pages, branch edit, payment + GST receipt PDF, expense create+APPROVED, lead create+status update, audit log, Excel exports, and counsellor branch/assignment isolation. Two blocking frontend bugs found and FIXED by testing agent: (1) ErpLayout race-condition redirect, (2) useEffect cleanup TypeError on Staff/Students/Expenses/Leads pages. After fixes, 100% of the requested frontend flows pass.
action_items: [FIXED by testing agent] ErpLayout.jsx — useEffect redirected to /login during AuthContext initial loading. Added `if (loading) return;` guard plus `loading` in deps. Without this, every page.goto('/erp/*') after login was bouncing back to /login because AuthContext starts with user=null until /auth/me resolves.

[FIXED by testing agent] ErpStaff.jsx / ErpStudents.jsx / ErpExpenses.jsx / ErpLeads.jsx all used the pattern `useEffect(reload, [...])` where `reload` returns a Promise (from `.then(setItems)`). React 18+ interprets the returned Promise as a cleanup function and throws "TypeError: destroy is not a function" on unmount. Wrapped each as `useEffect(() => { reload(); }, [...])`. ErpStaff was the only one we saw fail outright (red error overlay), but all four had latent bug.
Main agent: please review the four files above and decide if the wrapping should stay, or refactor reload to not return a Promise.

Optional UX: after successful login on /login?next=/erp the form currently navigates to /admin instead of honouring the `next` query param. Not blocking (direct navigation to /erp works after fix #1) but is a small papercut.
critical_code_review_comments: All four ERP list pages (Staff/Students/Expenses/Leads) share the same `useEffect(reload, [...])` anti-pattern. Consider a shared `useResource` hook to avoid this class of bug.
ErpLayout should also display a 'Loading…' skeleton while AuthContext is loading, instead of relying on the redirect-protection. Currently a tiny flash of unmounted state.

Receipt download link in ErpStudentDetail/ErpPayments embeds a bearer-less GET via `<a target=_blank>`. Works because cookies are sent cross-origin (sameSite=None + credentials=include), but if a user has cookies blocked the PDF download silently 401s. Consider a JS-driven fetch with Authorization header fallback like the Excel exports do.
AuthContext exposes `loading` but only ErpLayout (now) honours it — other gated routes (e.g., /admin) may have the same race. Worth auditing AdminDashboard guard.

`useEffect(reload, …)` is also a hidden bug magnet because `reload` is recreated every render — works today only because the dep array is primitives, but any future memo refactor will retrigger infinite loops.

rca of the issue: Two root causes addressed by testing agent: (1) ErpLayout's effect fired with user=null during AuthContext bootstrap (refresh() pending), causing redirect to /login. Reproduction: full page load to /erp after fresh login → bounced. Mitigation: gate the effect on `!loading`. (2) React 18 strict mode runs effect cleanup, but `useEffect(reload, deps)` where reload returns Promise<undefined> means React calls `Promise.then(...).destroy()` → TypeError. Reproduction: navigate to /erp/staff, an uncaught error overlay rendered. Mitigation: wrap with arrow function so cleanup is undefined.
